p: up: The gates and walls were broken down.
gate between the two walls: Which was a postern door, read 2Ki 25:4.
Riblah in the land of Hamath: Which is called Antioch in Syria.
poor of the people: For the rich and the mighty who put their trust in their shifts and means, were by God's just judgments most rigorously handled.
even as he shall say to: Thus God preserved his prophet by his means, whom he made the scourge to punish the king, and them that were his enemies.
Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the: Whom the king of Babel had now appointed governor over the rest of the Jews that he left behind.
hast put thy trust in me: Thus God recompensed his zeal and favour which he showed to his prophet in his troubles.
